title: Inside Man
tagline: The perfect heist needs a perfect lunch.
about: A clever bank robbery in Manhattan becomes a battle of wits with a sharp detective.
cue: Serve the pizza when the hostages get their delivery.
faces: Heroes cut to order. Coffee all day. Around the corner from the bank.
Lunch run to the command post out front. Heroes for twenty.
Seared hard, sliced thin, jammy onions, rocket, horseradish cream, toasted bread.
Genoa salami, capicola, ham, provolone, hot peppers.
Potato, onion cooked slow in butter, white pepper, flaky dough, baked golden. Hot mustard.
Sixteen thin rounds, tomato, mozzarella, pepperoni.
Prices subject to change. New York, N.Y. 2006.
A double shot over ice and tonic water, an orange slice. Stir before you sip.
Steamed milk, a thick cap of foam, cocoa on request.
Three almond layers, green, white and red, apricot jam between, dark chocolate on top.
Sirloin and Italian combo heroes, cut in thirds. Serves ten.
Two dozen, with a crock of hot mustard.
Coffee to go for the marble halls downtown.
I choose my words carefully and I never repeat myself.
Prices subject to change. Painters and contractors, coffee half price before 8 A.M.
